messages:
jordan: Putting together a proposal for auth fallthrough when project keys fail (quota/revoked/missing). Basic rule: project key -> service account -> org key, but with route annotations to prevent org-key for billing-sensitive endpoints. Feedback?

maya: Strong agree on annotations. Telemetry needed: auth.effective_key, auth.fallback_reason, auth.path. Counters: auth.fallback.count and auth.fallback.by_reason. Keep identifiers hashed. :mag:

ethan: Console UX: show badge like 'Used ORG KEY (fallback: quota)' with hover copy and link to dashboard. No raw key ids in UI.

maya: Minimal router proto sketch: fallback_policy: - when: QUOTA_EXCEEDED try: [SERVICE_ACCOUNT, ORG_KEY] - when: KEY_REVOKED try: [SERVICE_ACCOUNT] - when: PROJECT_NOT_FOUND try: [ORG_KEY] route_annotations: billing_sensitive, prefer_sa_admin

jordan: Edge cases: billing_sensitive routes must not fall back to org_key unless tenant opts in. Admin routes always prefer SA.

ethan: Rollout: feature flag tiered_auth_v1. Start staging 5%, sample traces with hashed_id, 48h obs -> 25% non-billing tenants -> 100. Include kill switch.

ops: Need exact console copy and dashboard link to wire alerts. Also runbook for customers relying on org key billing.

jordan: Badge copy draft: 'Used ORG KEY — fallback (quota)'. Hover: 'Used org-level key due to project quota. View details' -> /dashboards/auth-fallback?tenant=<tid>&trace=<trace_hash>. Confirm redaction.

maya: Redaction: metrics never include raw ids; store key_hash. Full ids only in ephemeral debug logs (7d) behind SRE RBAC. Dashboards for org admins show anonymized labels.

sre-bot: Created flag tiered_auth_v1; staging canary live 7723456800 (5%). Ephemeral debug logs enabled for canary, retention 7d. :white_check_mark:

ops: Add alert: auth.fallback.rate_for_billing_routes > 1% -> P2 to ops oncall. Ops will own runbook.

jordan: Next steps I own: 1) add fallback_policy proto + tests, 2) implement telemetry hooks, 3) console badge + dashboard link, 4) canary playbook and kill switch. Will open PRs and tag reviewers.

maya: Please include checklist in PR: dashboards, alert, sampling logs, RBAC gate, UX copy, unit tests. I'll review.

ethan: Suggested paths: pkg/auth/router/fallback_policy.proto, pkg/auth/router/eval.go, web/ui/components/AuthFallbackBadge.tsx, infra/flags/tiered_auth_v1.yaml

jordan: PR posted WIP: https://git.internal/redwood/p/fallback-policy. Will drop playbook and UX mocks here when ready.

sre-bot: Staging canary observed 9 fallback events in first 30m; sampling logs captured 2 traces.

ops: Linking dashboard ticket: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/boards/789 for wiring and alert hooks.
